hooks.command: root=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel) && test -n "$root" && test -f "$root/99_Tools/CodexGuard/codex-hook.mjs" || { printf '%s\n' 'Error deny: CodexGuard project root or entry is unavailable.' >&2; exit 2; }; node "$root/99_Tools/CodexGuard/codex-hook.mjs"
hooks.commandWindows: (for /f "delims=" %I in ('git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2^>nul') do @if exist "%I/99_Tools/CodexGuard/codex-hook.mjs" (node "%I/99_Tools/CodexGuard/codex-hook.mjs" & exit /b)) & echo Error deny: CodexGuard project root or entry is unavailable. 1>&2 & exit /b 2
